adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff changed removal logic to `group.users.delete(user_id)` (then `group.save`). This bypasses any domain-specific removal method (the previous codepaths used `group.remove(user)`), and `delete` on an association will no-op if the user isn’t a member, so the action can return `success_json` even when nothing was removed. However, the claim about “bypassing GroupUser callbacks/counter-cache leaving user_count stale” is not directly verifiable from this diff (no join model/callbacks/counter-cache behavior is shown), and idempotent deletes may be acceptable behavior.
